response.sql: WITH account_stats AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 as region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) as amount_avg, AVG(t.balance) as balance_avg FROM trans t INNER JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), region_stats AS (SELECT region, AVG(amount_avg) as region_amount_avg, AVG(balance_avg) as region_balance_avg FROM account_stats GROUP BY region), global_stats AS (SELECT AVG(region_amount_avg) as global_amount_mean FROM region_stats) SELECT rs.region, rs.region_amount_avg, rs.region_balance_avg, rs.region_amount_avg / gs.global_amount_mean as amount_avg_ratio FROM region_stats rs CROSS JOIN global_stats gs WHERE gs.global_amount_mean IS NOT NULL
